interface: Text tag region value.start / value.end in the JSON export
crlf: 2 (carriage return and line feed are one position each)

references.what: the text of each node is split with [...text], one array element per code point
normalizeText replaces every carriage return and every line feed separately, so CRLF keeps two positions
the project's own tests: 'Should calculate offsets by code points in text' (and in multiline text)

notes: Offsets from the Text tag; HyperText regions use XPath ranges plus globalOffsets and are not covered here.

version: master at commit ab6b765ea326 (latest release v1.8.5), v-annotator 0.1.28 at commit ab973f0ff806
interface: sequence labelling JSONL export (label / entities offsets)
offset_unit: utf16 (default); grapheme when the project's grapheme mode is on
emoji: U+1F600 counts 2 by default, 1 in grapheme mode

references.what: offsets come from the DOM selection (UTF-16 positions) and are converted to grapheme offsets only in grapheme mode
grapheme-splitter clusters mapped to positions with String.length (UTF-16 units)

notes: The code names these positions code points, but String.length and DOM selection offsets count UTF-16 code units.
